hero.eyebrow: The video engine for AI agents
hero.headlineA: Your AI agent can make videos.
hero.subtagline: Compose, validate, preview and render editable JSON templates—with your footage, typography, motion and music.
hero.privacy: Render locally. Keep your template editable.
hero.demoHint: No upload or camera needed. Try a sample template with included footage, entirely in your browser.

showcase.title: Every effect, one template away
showcase.subtitle: Light leaks, glints, frames, camera moves and cuts on the beat: explore editable templates and inspect their rendered results.
showcase.videoAria: A reel of LeClap motion effects, playing on a loop

film.title: One template. Every screen.
film.subtitle: 78 seconds, every shot rendered or recorded for real: the template, the engine, the browser, the phone and the agent.
film.name: LeClap — the film

mobile.title: Shoot and render, right on the phone.
mobile.subtitle: The same templates run on the phone: FFmpeg is compiled into the app, so your footage never leaves your hands.

pick.title: Pick a template
pick.body: Browse ready-made looks and choose the one that fits your story.

shoot.title: Shoot your clip
shoot.body: Film straight from the app, with a countdown and a framing guide.

render.title: Render it on the phone
render.body: FFmpeg composes the finished video on the device. No server, no upload.

result.title: Your video, finished
result.body: Titles, grade and lower third baked in, ready to post, and still on your phone.

mobile.phoneAria: A phone running the LeClap app
mobile.cta: Try the templates in your browser

screen.title: Making your video
screen.readyBody: Keep a copy or share your story.

agentic.title: Don’t describe the change. Show it.
agentic.subtitle: Your coding agent records the change, LeClap renders a short before/after video, and your workflow attaches it to the pull request.

implement.title: The agent implements
implement.body: It changes the product and states what the reviewer should look at.

record.title: It records before and after
record.body: Real screen recordings of the base branch and of the change, not generated footage.

render.title: LeClap validates and renders
render.body: The template is validated first, then composed into a deterministic video.

attach.title: Your workflow attaches it
attach.body: The reviewer presses play on the pull request instead of imagining the change.

agentic.cardAria: A pull request with a rendered before/after video attached
agentic.filmName: LeClap for agentic development — the film

features.title: From instructions to a finished video
features.subtitle: Give your agent structured tools, inspect the result and stay in control.

templates.title: Structured authoring
templates.description: A schema, motion catalog and runnable samples give your agent concrete building blocks.

forms.title: Human control
forms.description: Keep the editable JSON and open it in the visual builder to review and adjust the composition.

processing.title: Precise revisions
processing.description: Validate the template, inspect rendered frames and change the scenes that need work.

privacy.title: Local rendering
privacy.description: FFmpeg renders on your device. Your external AI provider has its own data handling.

wasm.title: MCP and CLI
wasm.description: Connect an MCP client or let an agent use the command line to discover, preview and render.

crossPlatform.title: One template, multiple platforms
crossPlatform.description: Compose on Node, in the browser or in a native app. Supported effects and encoded pixels vary by backend.

workflow.title: A workflow you can inspect
workflow.subtitle: Your agent makes the creative decisions. LeClap turns an editable template and your assets into a video.

compose.title: Compose
compose.body: Start with a brief and assets. Discover a sample and author against the schema.

validate.title: Validate
validate.body: Check the template and inspect actual frames before rendering the full video.

revise.title: Revise
revise.body: Ask for a shorter intro or a new closing line. Update the relevant scenes.

render.title: Render
render.body: Export the finished video and keep the template for the next revision.

product.title: Product demos
product.body: Turn real screen recordings into a clear product walkthrough.

social.title: Branded social clips
social.body: Reuse your copy, colors and assets across editable compositions.

review.title: PR evidence
review.body: Give reviewers a before/after video of the actual change.
